scientific_limitations: The exact maximum is asserted for prime cyclic groups only when the prime is 3 modulo 4; the 1 modulo 4 maximum is not computed.
The spectral deficit identity is exact, but the two autocorrelation-variance comparison constants are not claimed optimal.
For composite group orders, existence and isomorphism classification of equality-case difference sets are not addressed.
An equivalent stability identity may be implicit in older difference-set, perfect-sequence, or frame literature under another norm convention.
title: Exact half-density Fourier-algebra deficit and difference-set stability
